author: SickProdigy
description: Query AzerothCore through SOAP and an optional read-only MySQL adapter for character profiles, online players, AI companions, and leaderboards.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild settings and reads configured public character statistics. Database credentials are kept in Red shared API tokens and are never included in Discord output.
install_msg: SOAP remains optional and backward compatible. For character profiles and leaderboards, create a least-privilege read-only database account, then configure the `azerothcore_mysql` shared API tokens documented in the cog README. Run `[p]azerothcore databasecheck` before using `[p]azerothcore player` or `[p]azerothcore leaderboard`.
name: AzerothCore
short: AzerothCore SOAP tools and read-only character statistics
